cold_separate: Invocation creation/backing and first prepare/native preparation
Initialization, first touch, full numerical oracle and exactly 8 symmetric complete warmup replays
warm_charged: Bind persistent input/output views as required by each original public route
One submit or both microbatch submits before wait
All original CPU/native math, bridge copies/repack, staging/UMA copies, native waits/observation
Checked owning results, release of returned owners and real native accepted-prefix retirement
Original Scheduler.drain before the timed logical replay returns; no accepted work escapes timing

While each successful ResultLease is alive, get its host output and use storage.subview(0, sizeof(float)).read(one_float) as a minimal checked observable read; both microbatch outputs are observed. Then release every lease/view before drain.
outside_warm: Before/after timed epochs, a separate complete untimed replay of identical original public calls supplies full independent output qualification. Keep each successful ResultLease alive through the entire output read/oracle, then drop it and drain. This is not a claim to read the final timed output.
No borrowed Results output view escapes its ResultLease. No uncharged final timed owner retention or post-release access.

Cold compile/native preparation reported separately and allocation-order labelled; vendor first-user initialization may differ by allocation order, so these cold diagnostics do not sign a 5% cold comparison.
deferred_symmetric: Persistent Context/queues/Scheduler, CompiledProgram/Invocation/backings and static/native caches remain alive across warm replays on BOTH sides. Their final close/destruction and facade DSO unload are outside warm, separately accounted diagnostic teardown; per-step drain does not destroy these persistent resources.
Every per-replay returned view/result/lease and all accepted prefix work still retire inside warm before return. No final timed result owner escapes to teardown.

Provider/driver-private late callback, free and cache reclamation costs remain UNKNOWN where the public completion contract cannot resolve them. Neither zero total-process cost nor complete private allocator reclamation is claimed.

fixed_measurement.logical_unit: one full branch/join or one full one/two-slot chain journey
fixed_measurement.controls: Preserve original workload A/A, known delta5/delta10, timer-floor and applicable code placement controls; fixed dual execution and allocation orders. No manual sleep/late size/iteration tuning.

baseline_reuse.product_equivalence: git diff for src/include/cmake/root CMake between qualified G08 SDK candidate and G09 baseline is empty. Other changes are docs/evidence/G08 benchmarks. Must still rehash each actual old SDK prefix and compiler/linkage identity.
baseline_reuse.linux_artifact_limit: The earlier G08 qualified-sdk-cuda.json points to a WSL ELF static archive with local-exec TLS relocations; it cannot be linked into a facade.so by adding -fPIC to only the facade. That artifact is NOT selected here: current CUDA P1 uses the actual Windows PE SDK. WSL remains correctness/device risk coverage; no new PIC build or P1 platform expansion.

reference_proposal.kind: Two private benchmark facade DSOs, each statically linked to its own complete qualified HYLE SDK; identical public consumer source, compiler flags and workloads; baseline original code unmodified.
reference_proposal.isolation: Opaque state and scalar/POD C function table only; all HYLE C++ ownership and deletion stays in its own facade. Export whitelist and symbol/binding audit must prove no HYLE private weak/type/data symbol interposition between baseline and candidate. Original unchanged vendor dynamic dependencies may be shared with explicit hashes.
reference_proposal.driver: Existing nanobench/perf_process and hyle-perf instrument; private facade is consumer adapter only, no public API, new benchmark framework or perf-core edits.
reference_proposal.rejection: If object/export/weak/binding isolation or real native dispatch/copy accounting cannot be proved, reject adapter before any formal sampling; do not treat identical labels or SDK files as a performance result.
